kebab_example: aliyun live start-rtc-cloud-transcode --app-id 00000000-7074-0000-9ef5-85c19a400000 --channel-id myChannel --input-param '{"SingleSubUserParam":{}}' --output-params TranscodeTemplate=lhd UserId=userA_360p ChannelId=myChannel UserToken=eyJhcHBpZCI00000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartRtcCloudTranscode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application to which the channel belongs. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 频道所属的应用 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to which the user to be transcoded belongs. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 待转码用户所属的频道 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符
parameters.name: channel_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the video input stream. This parameter is valid only if the subscribed media type includes a video stream. Valid values:

0 (default): The camera stream.

1: The screen sharing stream. (This value is not supported. The setting is invalid.)
fields.help_zh:
订阅的视频输入流类型，仅订阅媒体类型包含视频流有效。取值：

0（默认值）：摄像头。
1：屏幕共享。（暂不支持，设置无效）
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The media type of the subscribed stream. Valid values:

0 (default): The original stream, which includes both the audio and video streams.

1: The audio-only stream. (This value is not supported. The setting is invalid.)

2: The video-only stream. (This value is not supported. The setting is invalid.)
fields.help_zh:
订阅用户的媒体类型。取值：

0（默认值）：原始流，包含音频与视频流。
1：仅音频流。（暂不支持，设置无效）
2：仅视频流。（暂不支持，设置无效）
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the user whose stream you want to subscribe to
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The input parameters for a single-stream subscription
fields.name: single_sub_user_param

parameters.help_en: The parameters for the input stream subscription
parameters.name: input_param

fields.help_en: The ID of the channel to which the transcoded stream is pushed. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters. (Pushing streams to a different channel is not supported. This setting is invalid.)
fields.help_zh: 转码流转推到的频道ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。（暂不支持转推到不同的频道，设置无效）
fields.name: channel_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the transcoding template. Valid values:

alimcopy

lld

lsd

lhd

lud
fields.help_zh:
转码模板名。取值：

alimcopy
lld
lsd
lhd
lud
fields.name: transcode_template

fields.help_en: The user ID for the transcoded stream in the destination channel. This ID must be unique within the channel
fields.help_zh: 转码流转推到频道的用户ID，需保证与频道内其它用户ID不同
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The token required to push the transcoded stream to the channel. For more information, see Token-based authentication (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/apsaravideo-live/latest/token-based-authentication)
fields.help_zh: 转码流转推到频道所需的用户Token，详见Token鉴权 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/live/token-based-authentication)
fields.name: user_token

parameters.help_en: The parameters for the transcoded output
parameters.name: output_params

parameters.help_en: The idle timeout period in seconds. If a task cannot subscribe to the specified streamer's stream and remains idle for longer than this period, the task automatically stops. The value must be an integer from 10 to 14,400. The default value is 300
parameters.help_zh:
空闲超时时间，当任务处于空闲状态（订阅不到指定主播流）的时长超过一定时间会自动停止。
单位为秒，范围须在[10,14400]内，即最大 4 小时，默认为 300 秒
parameters.name: max_idle_time

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the cloud transcoding job
